about: The blind test (Denning, November 2026 review): sealed moments where Denning's call and the model's are both recorded before the outcome is read. A round is added after every training chunk and never refreshed: open rounds wait until Denning answers them on the site (Model > Blind test). Each pick carries the model's call, the usual play, and a sealed part (base64, never printed: the actual choice, its win-chance change, and the mean win-chance change of each choice among the 15 most similar decisions in other matches). Scoring: each call's expected win-chance change in that situation, and whether it matched what the team did.

picks.denning_reason: EDGE's full team should collapse (including 2 monks). EDGE lost 5 players, and hook is pushing their base from 2 sides. EDGE is 12s away from base res. EDGE needs their whole team back in base to be ready to fight 8v8 to push hook out after the base res. Any EDGE characters that stay outside are at risk of getting cut off from their team and dying to hooks full damage if hook falls out frontdoor.
